thread:
julia_csm: FYI Lumina Labs on renewal call — they want to add 10 seats mid-term and convert to a 6‑month prepaid bundle instead of a monthly add-on. Procurement insists on PO + wiring for upfront. They also asked to keep current seat price. Need AE + Finance + Legal alignment before I send an amendment.

mike_ae: thanks. do we have their current seat rate and exact effective date?

julia_csm: current paid seats 120. seat rate we bill them is $450/month. they want 10 seats for 6 months, effective 2026-05-01 (they prefer next billing cycle).

anton_finance: quick calc: 10 * $450 * 6 = $27,000. Options: invoice pro-rata for remainder of current period + 6mo prepaid, or invoice full 6mo upfront. procurement prefers upfront wire. monthly bump would be +$4,500/mo. For wiring — we need vendor entity name and PO on invoice.

legal_ana: who will sign? amendment vs new SOW? if amendment, short addendum is fine. confirm signer name/email and whether eSign via DocuSign is acceptable. Also confirm PO number requirement.

julia_csm: procurement contact Elena (elena@lumina.com). signer will be CTO Carlos Ortega. They require PO on invoice and net30 terms. They also want CSV roster for onboarding.

mike_ae: I'll draft an amendment: 6mo bundle at current seat rate, PO number on invoice, invoiced upfront net30, wiring details appended. I'll request Carlos to sign via DocuSign.

julia_csm: @mike_ae please add clause: "no automatic renewal of the prepaid term" — customer asked for flexibility.

mike_ae: will do, and will CC CS for onboarding kickoff.

anton_finance: note: if invoiced upfront, revenue ops needs to lock the seat count for the prepaid term. cc @revenue_ops. also set tax jurisdiction to CA on invoice.

revenue_ops: ack — will validate seat roster once PO arrives.

julia_csm: timeline: Mike to send amendment draft by EOD. Elena to send PO and Carlos to sign via DocuSign. I'll prepare onboarding checklist and loop in provisioning.

mike_ae: draft attached (link). key excerpt:

```text
Amendment: Add 10 seats to Agreement #2024-LL-001. Term: 6 months starting 2026-05-01. Total: $27,000. Billing: Invoice upfront, net30, to Lumina Labs Inc. PO required. Signer: Carlos Ortega (CTO).
```

julia_csm: perfect. @legal_ana can you review the "no auto-renewal" and refund language?

legal_ana: quick read looks fine. recommendation: no refunds after invoice paid; offer credits only at vendor discretion. if they push, we can offer pro‑rata refund clause but prefer to avoid.

julia_csm: agree — no refunds.

docu_sign_bot: Document (Amendment_Lumina_10seats_2026) sent to carlos.ortega@lumina.com via DocuSign at 2026-04-12T15:02:11Z.

julia_csm: Carlos signed at 2026-04-12T18:10:03Z. Elena said procurement will send PO today.

anton_finance: once PO arrives, i'll queue invoice for $27,000 with the PO# and wiring instructions.

julia_csm: onboarding kickoff scheduled for 2026-05-03 10:00 PT. Need seat CSV by 2026-04-28. Elena expects to provide PO + roster by EOD.

mike_ae: closing loop — added onboarding tag and assigned to @onboard_sam.

onboard_sam: got it. will coordinate seat provisioning and kickoff meetings, and confirm seat CSV format.

julia_csm: thanks team :tada:
